name: io.github.Adiakys/otlpdashboard
title: OtlpDashboard
description: Query OpenTelemetry logs, traces and metrics from a self-hosted OTLP dashboard

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: OTLP HTTP ingestion, web app and MCP endpoint

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Volume that keeps the telemetry database across restarts

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by DASHBOARD__BROWSERTOKEN, when that token is set

environmentVariables.name: DASHBOARD__BROWSERTOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the web app, read API and MCP endpoint. Leave empty for open access
